name: Find the Unicorns 🦄
desc:
🦄 Welcome to Find The Unicorns! Search through the map and collect cute unicorns!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden unicorns
🏆 Find all unicorns the fastest for a spot on the leaderboard

🤝 Find unicorns with friends and meet new friends along the way!
🎒 Equip the unicorns you collect!
💬 If you want to suggest NEW unicorns , post a message on the 52 Cards group wall.
